mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises above 4.0% in a month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and retail sales signals a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and RSAFS decline in the same month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.5% and sustained for 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 2.5% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales above its 6-month moving average indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 6-month moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 108.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 108.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a robust labor market and strong housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST increases and UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales above 520,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 520000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
